views.rationale: Other operating expense (income) net was $86 million in Q2 2019 versus $80 million in Q2 2018, indicating higher costs.
Revenue for the six months ended June 30 fell to $38.7 billion from $47.6 billion a year earlier, a ~19% decline.
Second‑quarter 2019 sales increased 3% to $14.432 billion versus $14.011 billion in Q2 2018.
Net income attributable rose to $6.954 billion from $4.305 billion a year earlier.
Revenue grew 19% YoY (22% in constant currency) for the quarter ended June 30, 2019
Corporate loans increased from $37.3B to $43.0B (≈5.7% rise) between Dec 2018 and June 2019
Worldwide sales fell 0.6% YoY in the first six months of 2019, with a 3.3% negative currency impact
Reported sales jumped 137% YoY for the quarter ending June 30, 2019, driven primarily by a merger
